proposals.before: His uncle by marriage, Minister Over the Masses Can, and his maternal uncle, General Who Pacifies the West Cai Xingzong, both valued him highly.
proposals.after: His collateral paternal uncle, Minister Over the Masses Can, and his maternal uncle, General Who Campaigns West Cai Xingzong, both valued him highly.
proposals.reason: 從叔 means collateral paternal uncle, not uncle by marriage; 征西 is campaign-west, not pacify-west (安西).

proposals.before: His uncle by marriage, Minister Over the Masses Can, and his maternal uncle, General Who Pacifies the West Cai Xingzong, both held him in esteem.
proposals.after: His collateral paternal uncle, Minister Over the Masses Can, and his maternal uncle, General Who Campaigns West Cai Xingzong, both held him in esteem.
proposals.reason: Same errors as idiomatic: 從叔 and 征西 mistranslated.

decisions.reason: s0013 has 從叔司徒粲 and 征西將軍蔡興宗; 從叔 is a collateral paternal uncle, not an uncle by marriage, and 征西 is campaign-west, not pacify-west (安西/平西).
